# fixtures

## Contents

- [fixtures](#fixtures)

This folder holds the fixture data of the suite. A fixture is data that a test reads as given. The exact state of the data is part of the test condition.

**Belongs here:** The environment fixture set, and fixture data of the same kind.

**Does not belong here:** Code. Code that reads a fixture lives with the case or the test that reads it.

`env-fixtures.json` states the environment shapes that the battery case and the tests read.

**Next:** The [battery folder](../battery/README.md) states the case that reads this fixture set.
